QLabel.name: override_intro
QLabel.text: Short path on Windows: load the small binary capability blob the GPU reads from the monitor (or a file), optionally tweak it, then install a reversible registry override. This does not flash the monitor's hardware EEPROM—that is only on the EEPROM tab.

QPushButton.name: refresh_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Reload the monitor list from Windows.

QGroupBox.name: data_group
QGroupBox.title: Step 2 - Load, decode, or edit EDID data

QPushButton.name: read_active_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Load what Windows is using now from the display chain—the effective capability blob (not only the optional registry override layer).

QPushButton.name: read_override_button
QPushButton.tooltip: If a Windows EDID override is installed for this monitor, load that registry layer (may be empty).

QPushButton.name: save_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Save the current working EDID/DisplayID to a file.

QTextEdit.name: text_box
QTextEdit.placeholder: Raw EDID hex will appear here.

QPlainTextEdit.name: decoded_preview_box
QPlainTextEdit.placeholder: Decoded EDID details will appear here.

QLabel.name: current_data_label
QLabel.text: Nothing loaded yet. Read from the selected monitor or load a file.

QPushButton.name: load_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Load EDID/DisplayID data from BIN, DAT, TXT, or INF.

QLabel.name: apply_hint
QLabel.text: Install or remove an optional Windows registry layer for the monitor in Step 1. The OS treats it like a patched capability file—reversible, no hardware flash. Restart the display driver (Driver Maintenance tab) or reboot if nothing changes immediately.

QPushButton.name: install_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Writes a Windows registry override. This is reversible and safer than EEPROM writing.

QPushButton.name: override_remove_button
QPushButton.tooltip: Removes the EDID override for the display selected in Step 1. Active EDID cache is preserved.
